title: 我们换个角度来看什么是主体性！

coverage.excluded_asr_tail: S00025-S00035 extend beyond the audited media duration and are excluded from claims.

timeline.summary: A viewer asks how to cultivate subjectivity; Mikey begins with a game metaphor.
He asks whether one could verify that the world continues after one's death and presents non-continuation as a thought experiment, not evidence.
He imagines the world as belonging to the viewer, labels surrounding people NPCs and says seeing oneself as the sole protagonist produces subjectivity.

He reframes the world as an amusement park entered with a ticket from one's parents; other people, including Mikey, provide clues or value in the viewer's world. The cut ends before the ASR's hallucinated tail.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He uses a game metaphor to cultivate agency: regard yourself as the protagonist responsible for exploring and choosing in your own life.
claims.conditions: A philosophical exercise about personal agency, not a literal claim that reality disappears after death.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He describes everyone else as NPCs and only oneself as the protagonist.
claims.conditions: Dehumanizing if applied literally; it cannot reduce other people's autonomy, rights, consent or independent interests.

claims.conditions: Use only as a metaphor for responsibility and selective learning.
